annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 841/2024 - Altera a Lei nº 8.078/1990 para tornar obrigatória a exibição de aviso ao consumidor sobre imagem ou vídeo publicitário produzido com o uso de inteligência artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 841/2024 - Amends Law No. 8.078/1990 to require a notice to consumers on advertising images or videos produced using artificial intelligence
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 841/2024 amends the Consumer Defense Code (art. 30) to require that advertising containing AI-generated images or videos carry a legible warning, aiming to prevent deceptive advertising and protect consumers. It concerns generative AI labelling and has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds a sole paragraph to art. 30 of Lei 8.078/1990 (Consumer Defense Code).
Advertising with AI-produced images or videos must display a legible-size notice alerting consumers.
Justification: avoid misleading advertising when consumers cannot distinguish AI images from real ones.
